entries.english:
Disputes between Rosenberg and Rothenburg ob der Tauber.

Term: (1481, 1521) 1551–1578, 1597–1606

Contents:
1. Fol. 1–36: Disputes over rents and interest due from properties in the Niederstetten district owned by residents of Wildentierbach; arbitration proceedings, (1481) 1552–1564.
2. Fol. 37–47: Disputes over tithes from a field in the Münster district belonging to Klaus Meuter of Lichtel, 1557.
3. Fol. 48–67: Inspection in the dispute between the communities of Lichtel and Münster, 1605–1606.
4. Fol. 70–97: Disputes over interest claimed by Rosenberg from a meadow belonging to the miller Kaspar Rahn of Lichtel, 1571.
5. Fol. 102–139: District-boundary disputes between Oberstetten and Niederstetten; disputes over tithes, 1551–1558.
6. Fol. 141–170: Hay-tithe disputes at Wildentierbach, (1521) 1569–1573, 1597.
7. Fol. 171–190: Wine-tithe disputes at Oberstetten, 1557, 1575–1578.

Extent: 1 volume, fol. 1–190.
